correctness.rationale: The Gram eigenvalue and pairwise determinant identities follow by elementary trigonometry and Cauchy–Binet. The rank-defect locus is exactly the common-angle diagonal; Euclidean transverse coordinates yield Jacobian \(\sqrt m\) and expansion \(\lambda_{\min}=\lVert z\rVert^2+O(\lVert z\rVert^4)\). A dominated-convergence tube calculation produces the exact sharp tail for every continuous density. Strict Jensen equality and layer-cake integration yield the optimizer and inverse-risk cutoff; Fourier moment positivity forces the unique two-atom determinant maximizer. The exact two-sample CDF and deterministic standalone code replay supply corroborative checks only.
